correctness.rationale: PASS for the complete replacement files in /workspace/repairs/1, not for the frozen claim. The original physical caustic positions and R-inversion were false: the orthonormal rotated components of each cardinal unit vector are ±1/√2, so their stationary half-width is R/√2, not R. For R=1 and (cos φ,sin φ)=(4/5,3/5) the original even places the outer caustic at 4√2/5>1, outside the particle's deterministic norm bound R; the true four locations are ±4/5 and ±3/5. The verified repair uses normalized coordinates √2 U/R and √2 V/R, corrects both projection coefficients and gives R=√(s²+h²). The two telegraph signs are independent by the equal-rate product generator; zero flux yields f(u) proportional to (1−u²)^(β−1). The line projection hits only four corners at the four generic locations; away from them one can integrate in a fixed endpoint coordinate with smooth bounded z derivatives on the other factor. The same-sign corner convolution is a beta simplex integral with coefficient B(β,β); at the opposite-sign corner either side rescales to the same integrable kernel t^(β−1)(1+t)^(β−1), giving B(β,1−2β). Both include the factor 2^(2β−2)/( (ab)^β B(1/2,β)^2 ), now using corrected physical a,b. Reflection gives the ratio 1/[2 cos(πβ)], strictly increasing on the relevant interval. The critical corner integral is 2 arsinh√(L/|δ|), with a bounded correction, giving the stated logarithmic coefficient; above criticality the unscaled corner integral has an integrable majorant. The outer limit at criticality is 1/(2π√(ab)), and the disjoint inner-corner contributions add in the coalesced view. The original checker was inspected, not executed: its abstract a,b geometry never ties the projected square to the actual speed. The privately supplied replacement RESULT.md, CHECK.py and VERIFICATION.md fix those affected materials. The newly written replay `python3 /workspace/repairs/1/CHECK.py` passed two direct physical-geometry comparisons, four ratio checks, 24 subcritical and six critical density comparisons; those are finite checks, not the proof. The original files and verification front matter are preserved.
